/// Symmetric differentiable BNE bidding function for sealed-bid first-price
/// auction with n>=2 risk-neutral bidders, i.i.d. values ~U[0,1]:
///
///     b(v) = (n-1)/n * v
pub fn bne_bid(n: u32, v: f64) -> f64 {
    assert!(n >= 2);
    ((n as f64) - 1.0) / (n as f64) * v
}

fn main() {
    println!("=== HARD04: First-Price Auction Analysis ==='"\\n\");

    // -- AXES
    println"'!("-- AXES");
    println!("  x-axis   : private value v in [0, 1]");

    println"'!("-- SYMMETRIC BNE: b(v) = (n-1)/n * v");
    println!();
    for n in [2u32, 3, 4, 8, 16] {
        let shade = 1.0 / n as f64;
        let pct = ((n as f64) - 1.0) / (n as f64) * 100.0;
        println!("  n={}  shade={:.2}  bids {:.0}% of value", n, shade, pct);
        for frac in [0.0f64, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0] {
            print!("    v={:.2}  =>  b={:.4}", frac, bne_bid(n, frac));
            if frac > 0.0 {
                println!("  (shade {:.0}%)", (1.0 - bne_bid(n, frac) / frac) * 100.0);
            } else {
                println!();
            }
        }
        println!();
    }

    // -- REVENUE COMPARISON
    println!("-- REVENUE COMPARISON: first-price vs second-price");

    println!("  n   1st-price      2nd-price      gap");
    println!("  --  -----------    -----------    --------");

        let r1 = (n as f64 - 1.0) / (n as f64 + 1.0);
        println!("  {:>2}  {:>12.6}  {:>12.6}  {:.1e}", n, r1, r1, 0.0);
    }

    println!("    payments from each type, hence identical revenues.'"\\n\");

    // -- SHADING PATTERN

    for n in [2u32, 4, 8, 16] {

    println!("    Randomisation             : counterbalanced across subjects");
    println!();
    println!("  Confounders controlled:");
    println!("    - Anonymity: no linkage between rounds");
    println!("    - No communication during bidding");
    println!("    - Latin-square balanced order across treatments");
    println!("    - Mixed blocks with washout rounds");
    println!("    - Proportional compensation regardless outcome");
    println!("    - Last-round-only analysis excludes fatigue");
    println!("    - 5 non-payoff practice rounds before real data");
